1: The newer Bespoke Saints English (1).pdf governs, with accepted Genesis 1–11 as the English benchmark. It supersedes the older Founding Style Guide where their pronoun rules conflict: Thou/Thee/Thy/Thine address God directly; ordinary address uses you/your.

Preserved fruit/growth, power, light/darkness, inheritance, image/firstborn, body/head, fullness, blood/cross, flesh and mystery images. Modernized third-person forms and smoothed several clauses. At 1:7 changed our behalf to your behalf, and at 1:22 changed the inherited passive to He has reconciled you, following the consulted NA28 running text. Kept the bracketed repetition through Him at 1:20 and every person repeated three times at 1:28.

At 1:7, on your behalf replaces the inherited on our behalf; at 1:22, He has reconciled you replaces the inherited passive. Both follow the consulted NA28 running text; the earlier readings remain in the archive. The bracketed through Him at 1:20 is retained. The attachment of with joy at 1:11–12 remains open for review. God at 1:19 is a supplied subject in the inherited interpretation, not an explicit word at that point in Greek.
